title: shorea gardneri
intro: Shorea gardneri, commonly known as Belian, is a tropical tree species native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is a valuable medicinal plant with various health benefits, including its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Shorea gardneri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it effective in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Shorea gardneri include triterpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
